sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the psi SPARQL constraint's singular-input handling. Its FILTER(ABS(?sinAlpha) > ... ) and FILTER(ABS(?cosPhi2) > ... ) remove singular cases from the result, so singular inputs pass accidentally despite the message claiming rejection. Make the constraint report a violation when either |sin(alpha)| or |cos(phi2)| is at or below the singularity tolerance, and otherwise apply the registered math:sin, math:tan, and math:atan formula with the existing degree/radian conversion and expected-result-scaled tolerance. Preserve the existing target, operands, constants, units, and clamp.
